tournament.name: KARDS World Championship 2023 - Knockout
tournament.description:
Congratulations, Commander! You have made it through the intense battlefield of the KARDS 2023 World Championship open qualifiers, proving your immense skill and dedication! A perilous path lies ahead in the Knockout Stage, filled with the most skilled KARDS players in the world. For a complete set of rules for the World Championship, please visit the KARDS Help Center: https://support.kards.com/hc/en-us/articles/360034116852-KARDS-World-Championship-rules

Dates The dates for the Knockout Stage are as follows: Knockout 1 (round robin group stage): October 21st Deck submission deadline: October 21st at 12:00 UTC+0 Start time: 13:00 UTC+0 Knockout 2 (double elimination top 32): October 22nd Deck submission deadline: October 22nd at 12:00 UTC+0 Start time: 13:00 UTC+0 Knockout 3 (double elimination top 6): October 29th Deck submission deadline: October 26th at 23:59 UTC+0 Start time: 13:00 UTC+0 FORMAT Tournament formats will be the following for the Knockout Stage: For the Round Robin (groups) stage, players need to submit three decks from three different main nations and play in a best of 5 series versus each players in the pool. No bans, conquest. For the Double Elimination (knockout stage), players need to submit four decks from four different main nations and each player will ban one deck from their opponent during each best of 5 series. Conquest. Note: The remainder of the World Championship will be played conquest style, meaning that you cannot use a deck again once it has won a match in a series. SEEDING For the groups (Round Robin) stage, pre-qualified players are pre-seeded into groups, so they are evenly spread throughout. Other players are drawn into groups after this. Group drawings will happen during a live drawing stream on October 13th at 16:00 GMT. The knockout (Double Elimination) stage will be seeded based on the final results of the group (Round Robin) stage.
